notes: The booklet is a low-resolution 3D drawing set and several steps (3-7 plates, 8-12 ring plates, 17-18 roof) are ambiguous. Exact stacking is my best reading; the type, colour and count of every piece matches the parts list (74 pieces).
Plates that are clipped to the underside of the 12-long bricks (b4, b5, b58) are recorded with rests_on pointing to the bricks they clutch, since they clutch pieces rather than sit on them.

KEPT AS TWO GROUPS ON PURPOSE: the shovel (b74, lego-3837) is the only piece not joined to the tractor. The booklet shows it only as the minifigure's hand-held tool (page 3 and step 21). The minifigure itself is not in the parts list, so there is nothing for the shovel to be held by. The booklet shows no step that attaches the shovel to the tractor, so any join would be invented. The other 73 pieces form one connected tractor. This is a real separate item, not a missed connection.
The sticker sheet is a single part (b45); the wheat sticker is on the red brick at step 14 and the second sticker (grille) at step 21 comes from the same sheet.
Steps 4-5: both friction pins and the yellow bar are placed by the end pin holes at the rear; the bar passes through the pins.

The tipper (steps on page 16) is built as a sub-assembly: 2x2 plate with pin holes, two blue axle pins, two pole reverser handles, and the tipper bed on top. It is attached at step 19 by the reverser axles going into the axle holes of the two angled connectors (b13, b14).
Step 20: one 7L axle passes through both rear wheels and the pin holes of the two 1x2 Technic bricks. The front wheels go on the pins of the wheel holder plate (b58).
Red 1x6 plates (b33, b34) are placed under the wheel arches (b43, b44) as the wheel arch is mounted on a plate row.
